project_name: SAP Business ByDesign - Purchase Order Creation Hub
context_type: DASHBOARDS & ADMIN PANELS / ENTERPRISE PROCUREMENT TOOL

typography.h1_style: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 tracking-tight font-heading flex items-center gap-3
typography.h2_style: text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight font-heading flex items-center justify-between
typography.section_title: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 font-heading mb-3 flex items-center gap-2

layout_and_spacing.table_density: compact high-density ERP style (cell padding py-2 px-3)

key_sections.title: Page Header & SAP Live Sync Status
key_sections.description: Top breadcrumbs, live SAP system indicator, page title with badges indicating live SAP PO creation mode, and quick stats bar.

key_sections.title: 1. Organization & Routing Context
key_sections.description: Purchase Unit (Site) selector which dynamically auto-derives Company (Business Residence: RI vs RT) with a clear explanation badge, and unlocks the scoped Bill-To party code options.

key_sections.title: 2. Supplier Master & Commercial Terms
key_sections.description: Live autocomplete search for SAP Supplier (code/name), showing auto-fetched read-only Payment Terms from Supplier Master (e.g. '0010 - 30 days from Invoice Date'), PO Date picker, optional Portal PR reference number, and Currency dropdown (INR default).

key_sections.title: 3. Line Items Engine
key_sections.description: High-density multi-row table supporting Product ID autocomplete search, auto-filling description & standard UoM, editable Quantity, Unit of Measure (KGM, EA, MTR, etc.), Unit Price, per-line Delivery Date picker, line total calculation, duplicate row, and delete row.

key_sections.title: 4. Order Summary & Pre-Flight Validation
key_sections.description: Sticky summary panel presenting total line count, total units, gross order value formatted in JetBrains Mono font, automated completeness checklist, and SAP safety warnings.

key_sections.title: 5. Weight-of-Action Verification & Submit
key_sections.description: Primary 'Create Purchase Order in SAP' button triggering a detailed Modal Audit Recap before pushing to SAP. Success result dialog displays the returned SAP PO Number with a one-click CTA to 'View Created POs'.

components_to_use: Shadcn Select & SelectContent for site and bill-to choices
Shadcn Dialog for audit confirm and success result modals
Shadcn Input & Label for text and date entries
Shadcn Badge for status, payment terms, and company auto-derivation indicators
Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for icons (MagnifyingGlass, Plus, Trash, CheckCircle, WarningCircle, Buildings, CreditCard, Calendar, Truck, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck)
instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign `/app/frontend/src/pages/PurchaseOrderPage.jsx` into a high-density, rich enterprise procurement form with structured card panels, clear visual hierarchy, and an integrated sticky order summary sidebar.

Ensure all functional state handlers (sites API, supplier search, product search, company derivation, bill-to filtering, line item additions/deletions, date handling, validation logic, API submit payload) remain 100% operational and intact.
Display auto-fetched Payment Terms prominently once a supplier is selected (e.g. read-only badge/callout explaining it was loaded from the Supplier Master).
Calculate and display line item subtotals and grand order total formatted in currency (INR/USD) using `JetBrains Mono` font for precision.
Highlight auto-populated fields (Company, Payment Terms, Bill-To rules) with subtle blue/amber info badges so users understand SAP defaults.
Ensure every interactive input, button, select, dialog, and summary metric includes the specified `data-testid` attributes.
